policies.name: National Policy on Plastic Waste Management
policies.summary: Sets out producer responsibility, an eventual ban on single-use plastic bags in federal facilities, and targets for plastic recycling capacity.

newsFeed.headline: Lagos State enforces ban on single-use plastics and styrofoam packaging
newsFeed.summary: Africa's largest city began enforcing a ban on styrofoam takeaway containers, citing flooding caused by clogged drains.

wooby.headline: Lagos banned styrofoam to stop floods caused by clogged drains.
wooby.narrative: Wooby learned a sad fact: when plastic clogs drains, cities flood. Lagos in Nigeria banned styrofoam takeaway boxes after a bad flood. Wooby thinks the link between plastic and flooding is something every kid should know.
